from arc_dsl import *

def f(g):
    g=tuple(map(tuple,g))
    objs=objects(g,T,F,T)
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # reference shapes: normalized shapes of color-8 objects
    refs=[normalize(toindices(o)) for o in objs if next(iter(o))[0]==8]
    out=[list(r) for r in g]
